content:
name: Governed execution workspace read

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "Cargo.lock"
      - "crates/monad-core/**"
      - "specifications/technical/TECH-HARNESS-0002-governed-workspace-read-backend.md"
      - ".github/workflows/governed-execution-workspace-read.yml"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "Cargo.lock"
      - "crates/monad-core/**"
      - "specifications/technical/TECH-HARNESS-0002-governed-workspace-read-backend.md"
      - ".github/workflows/governed-execution-workspace-read.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  workspace-read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Verify formatting
        run: cargo fmt --check
      - name: Run governed workspace read tests
        run: cargo test -p monad-core harness_workspace_read
